# p10k-rs v0.3.0

**The v0.3 cycle opens with `p10k-rs init pwsh`.** Closes the gap from
v0.2.5–7 where `install.ps1`, the man page, and the Scoop README all
advertised `& p10k-rs init pwsh | Invoke-Expression` as the activation
recipe — but the subcommand didn't exist. v0.3.0 ships the missing
init script so the docs are honest end-to-end.

## What's new

### `p10k-rs init pwsh`

```pwsh
# Per-session:
& p10k-rs init pwsh | Invoke-Expression

# Persistent (add to $PROFILE):
Invoke-Expression (& p10k-rs init pwsh | Out-String)
```

The script wires a `global:prompt` function that calls
`p10k-rs prompt --shell pwsh --last-status $LASTEXITCODE
--last-duration-ms 0` on every PowerShell redraw. ANSI escapes flow
through natively in Windows Terminal and pwsh 7+; legacy conhost on
Win10 1809+ also works once VT processing is enabled (pwsh enables it
by default for PSReadLine sessions).

`Shell::Pwsh` accepts both `pwsh` (canonical) and `powershell` (legacy
5.x alias) — same init script either way.

## What's reduced on pwsh

Inherited from the Windows portability reductions
([`docs/src/windows.md`](https://github.com/scurran1986/powerlevel10k-rs/blob/v0.3.0/docs/src/windows.md)):

- `gitstatusd` daemon — falls back to `ShellOut` (no FIFO IPC).
- `command_execution_time` — segment hides (no clean pwsh preexec).
- Transient prompt — not wired today.
- Right-side prompt — `[layout.right]` silently dropped.

## Why "v0.3" not "v0.2.8"

Per `~/.planning/powerlevel10k-rs/ROADMAP.md`, PowerShell support is a
v0.3 "reach" deliverable. The other v0.3 items (Nushell, WASM custom
segments, structured event log, plugin / theme marketplaces) land in
later v0.3.x tags. Cutting v0.3.0 here signals the cycle pivot.

## Compatibility

- Schema unchanged. Bundled themes byte-for-byte identical.
- Wire-stability discipline preserved across all four diagnostic
  JSON surfaces.
- Unix users see no behavioural change.
- All six gates (Linux build / test / clippy / fmt / doc / Windows
  cargo check) stay green.

## Verification

```pwsh
p10k-rs --version              # 0.3.0
p10k-rs init pwsh | Out-String # emits the init script (sanity check)
& p10k-rs init pwsh | Invoke-Expression   # activate
```

```sh
# Unix users: unchanged.
p10k-rs init zsh | source /dev/stdin       # or eval, as before
```
